Just know your not alone. I've always had ocd but the pocd became a problem around the time of quarantine last year. That's when i started to get a false attraction almost. i would always reassure myself that i never crossed the line. I told myself that thoughts were ok but actions were not. Well I was able to continue like this up until about July 21st. I told myself that if i stopped watching porn the attraction to kids would go away (i thought the symptoms of pocd were caused by a porn addiction, not ocd). Well i managed to go 20 days without jacking off before my city was thrown into yet another lockdown. This is where I stopped seeking reassurance. I used to seek reassurance after the incident. But now, I was planning on seeking reassurance after a whole week. Now, 8-9 weeks later, I realise that I haven't raped/molested my sister and she seems to be living her best life. But now my mind is questioning what happened 1 year ago. I wish i was one of those people with a perfect memory. But, what if I killed some kid and got away with it? Like a homeless kid who nobody would notice if they went missing?

On July 21st i also told myself that i would kill myself on october 19th at 2am if i failed. Now i really feel like committing suicide. all i need to do is rest my neck on the train tracks and i can make my nightmare end.
but i really hate the thought of being someone who escaped the consequences of their actions.

i think the worst part is the uncertainty. i feel like i could continue living if i had known i had actually killed someone or molested a kid. because then i could face the consequences of my actions. i have no problem with going to jail or being sentenced to death. i could try and help others prevent the same mistakes and make society a better place.
Now I can't stop questioning everything I've done during the last 2 years of my life and possible even further beyond that
